BUILD SUCCESS. The change is complete.

## Summary

Changed the `customerCode` format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` with a per-city sequence:

- **`OwnerCustomerCodes`** — `format` now takes `city, lastName, sequence` and emits `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`. The three-letter prefix logic was already parameterized, so I generalized the private `prefix` helper (from `lastName` to a generic `value`) and reused it for both city and last name rather than duplicating it.

- **`AssignOwnerCustomerCode`** — the 4-digit sequence is now *per city*: one more than the number of existing owners already in the same city (counted from `findAll()`), instead of a global count. Passes the city through to the formatter.

- **`OwnerMapper.membershipNumber`** — no logic change needed: it already builds off `owner.getCustomerCode()`, so the membership number (and any other value derived from the code) automatically rebuilds on the new format. I only updated the Javadoc example to `LON-SMI-0007-M26`.

The new acceptance test (`coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix`, asserting `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`) and the full suite pass.
